_readme: A researched, live-verified starter bundle for scripts/discover-x-sources.ts. See docs/x-content-pipeline.md. Every handle here was fetched through the syndication path on 2026-09-06 and its timeline read by a human before being written down; the notes say what it actually posts. Nothing in a bundle can approve itself — these land as candidates for /admin/social-trends.

sources.notes: Comedian. 92 Arabic tweets, 66 clear the prefilter (72%). Verified dialect: 'للناس اللي لسة جايه تويتر.. اسمها تويتة مش بوست'. Everyday Egyptian, jokes and asides — the register the app teaches.
Comedian/actor. 92 Arabic tweets, 65 clear the prefilter (71%). Verified dialect: 'تحبوا تفطروا ايه؟ انا طابخ بنفسي.. في رز شايط وملوخيه صايصه'. Food and daily life in plain spoken Egyptian.
Footballer. 81 Arabic tweets, 71 clear the prefilter (88%) — the highest rate measured. Verified dialect: 'الفوز بالقمة ليه طعم تاني', 'متنساش اللى قلتلك عليه'.
Actor. 97 Arabic tweets, 68 clear the prefilter (70%).
Actor. 88 Arabic tweets, 47 clear the prefilter (53%). More promo than the comedians; still personal register.

Businessman, argues with people in public. 97 Arabic tweets, 72 clear the prefilter (74%). VERIFY: skews political commentary — read a page before approving.

VERIFY — a known prefilter false positive, kept as the worked example. Scores 78% because supplication ('اللهم', 'يا رب') reads as first/second person, but the register is devotional MSA, not dialect: 'اللهم إن الأرضَ أرضُك والسماءَ سماؤك'. The model screen should reject most of it. Reject this source unless a reviewer finds otherwise.

Singer. 98 Arabic tweets, 55 clear the prefilter (56%) — by a distance the best Yemeni account found. Verified spoken register: 'خلوها مفتوحة في قلوبكم', 'باقي اليوم وبكرة وبعد بكرة فصوتولي', 'لكل اللي يسألوني'.
VERIFY. Journalist. 41 Arabic tweets of 101 (much of the account is English), 21 clear the prefilter. Thin, but Yemeni personal accounts on X are scarce.

VERIFY. 97 Arabic tweets, 27 clear the prefilter (28%). Writes with Egyptian markers as often as Yemeni ('مافيش', 'مش مستبعد') — a reviewer should decide whether that helps or muddies the Yemeni column.
VERIFY — probably reject. 99 Arabic tweets, 29 clear the prefilter, but the sampled register is political MSA prose, not speech. Listed so the decision is recorded rather than rediscovered.
